title: Grateful Dead Live at Old Renaissance Faire Grounds on 1972-08-27

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a monster show highlighted by an iconic Dark Star and a standout Greatest Story Ever Told.
ai_review.review: The Kaplan–Hamilton tape delivers an exceptionally clean, well‑balanced soundboard mix that lets every instrument shine. Reviewers rave about the high energy performance – especially Jerry’s crisp guitar work, Bob’s tight interplay with him, and a career‑defining Dark Star – making this one of the band’s top shows. The recording quality is praised as the best available for this concert.

ai_rating.rationale: All four detailed reviews are highly positive (4‑5 stars), praising both an outstanding musical performance and excellent, crystal‑clear soundboard audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal clear mix with superb instrument balance, clean vocals, no noticeable hiss or dropouts; minor EQ tweaks optional but overall pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight and flowing set with seamless transitions, highlighted by an extended Dark Star that showcases the band's improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Crisp guitar tone and playing praised; standout performance throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Amazing interplay with Jerry, tight rhythm work noted.
